_comment: Promotion gates. Calibrated against the measured baselines on the real held-out splits (docs/FINE_TUNING.md, 'Measured baselines'): distribution metrics (length / char-3gram / surface features) must beat the v2.9-style retrieval replay and the untuned base model; token-F1 must beat a context-blind system that has perfect style (shuffled), which shows the model actually uses the conversation. unigram_js is not gated: it is dominated by long-tail sampling noise (see noise_floor in the report). Re-calibrate after the first measured run and keep the file versioned with the adapter.
